SELECT distinct decode(tpd.is_cancel,'Y',#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS03},#{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS02}) effectFlag,
FROM trd_product_deal tpd LEFT JOIN trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH wtpdo on wtpdo.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON tpda.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_registorg on fp.REGIST_ORG=sdl_registorg.ITEM_CODE and sdl_registorg.DICT_CODE='REGIST_ORG' LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON tpd.counter_id = mcp.counter_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FTP.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp3 ON fp3.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) OR tpd.B_TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) union all SELECT #{TRADE_FLOW_STATUS01} effectFlag,
FROM wfl_trd_product_deal tpd LEFT JOIN wfl_trd_product_deal_add tpda ON tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_OTH wtpdo on wtpdo.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tpdt on tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=tpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON tpda.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl_registorg on fp.REGIST_ORG=sdl_registorg.ITEM_CODE and sdl_registorg.DICT_CODE='REGIST_ORG' LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp ON tpd.counter_id = mcp.counter_id LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON tpd.sec_manage_acct_id = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FTP.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on tpd.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = tpd.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp3 ON fp3.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM wfl_trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) OR tpd.B_TRADE_ID = (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM wfl_trd_product_deal_add WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId})
